## Why This Is Asked

- Lock‑free circular buffers and jitter buffers

```javascript
// Minimal usage in JS
import {VoiceEngine} from 'react-native';
VoiceEngine.startVoiceEngine({sampleRate:48000, channels:1, bitrate:32000});
VoiceEngine.joinChannel('room-42');
VoiceEngine.onPacket((p)=> console.log('rx', p.size));
```

- How would you measure end-to-end latency accurately on Android and iOS?
